title: Uttar Pradesh UPESSC UP Primary Teacher Recruitment 2026 : Apply Online for 12405 Post
organization: Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC)
postName: Assistant Teacher in Urban Area Primary Schools / Assistant Teacher – Affiliated Primary (Non-Government Aided School)
vacancyDetails: 12405 primary teacher posts in Urban Area Primary Schools and Affiliated Primary (Non-Government Aided School) across Uttar Pradesh.
categoryWiseVacancyDetails: Assistant Teacher in Urban Area Primary Schools: 1508 posts; Assistant Teacher in Affiliated Primary (Non-Government Aided School): 10897 posts; total 12405 posts. See the official district-wise vacancy PDF for the complete category and district distribution.
qualification: Bachelor's degree from a recognized university along with a recognized teacher training qualification such as BTC / D.El.Ed / B.El.Ed / Special BTC or equivalent as per NCTE norms, and mandatory pass in the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET).
ageLimit: Minimum age 21 years; maximum age 40 years as on 01/07/2026. Age relaxation as per UPESSC rules.
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS: ₹1000; SC / ST: ₹500; PH (Divyang): ₹300. Fee can be paid online through debit card, credit card, net banking or UPI.
selectionProcess: Online Application → UPESSC Primary Teacher Examination → Document Verification → Final Selection
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, mark sheets, teacher training qualification certificate, TET certificate, photograph, signature, ID proof, category certificate if applicable, domicile certificate if required, and all documents mentioned in the official notification
howToApply:
1. Visit the official UPESSC recruitment website or the application portal when it is activated
2. Complete OTR registration and login
3. Fill in personal, academic and contact details carefully
4. Upload required documents and pay the fee
5. Review the form and submit it
6. Save the final submitted form and application number for future reference
shortDescription: UPESSC has released the UP Primary Teacher Recruitment 2026 notification for 12405 posts under Advt. No. 05/2026. Applications are open from 16 September 2026 to 15 October 2026.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has issued the notification for UP Primary Teacher Recruitment 2026 under Advt. No. 05/2026.

Eligible candidates can submit the online application from 16/09/2026 to 15/10/2026. The UPESSC Primary Teacher examination is scheduled for 03-04 December 2026. Read the official notification before applying for the complete eligibility, syllabus, fee and vacancy details.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 16/09/2026
  • Last Date for Registration: 15/10/2026
  • Pay Exam Fee Last Date: 15/10/2026
  • Last Date Correction: 19/10/2026
  • UPESSC Primary Teacher Exam Date: 03-04 December 2026
  • Exam City: Before exam
  • Admit Card: Before exam
  • Answer Key: As per schedule
  • Result: As per schedule

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS: ₹1000
  • SC / ST: ₹500
  • PH (Divyang): ₹300

Fee is to be paid online only through debit card, credit card, net banking or UPI.

Age Limit

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 40 years as on 01/07/2026

Age relaxation is applicable as per UPESSC rules.

Vacancy Details

  • Total Posts: 12405
  • Assistant Teacher in Urban Area Primary Schools: 1508
  • Assistant Teacher in Affiliated Primary (Non-Government Aided School): 10897

District-wise vacancy details are available in the linked official vacancy PDF. Candidates should verify the complete distribution and eligibility from the notification before submitting the form.
